import novamind_api as nm
import json

print("Cash before:", nm.vars.cash if hasattr(nm.vars, 'cash') else 'n/a')

# 1. Start T11 ($2.5M)
r = nm.research.start_research_project(tier=11)
print("T11 start:", json.dumps(r, default=str)[:400])

# 2. Discovery burst: research_market x6 ($150K)
for i in range(6):
    r = nm.market.research_market()
    print(f"research_market #{i+1}:", json.dumps(r, default=str)[:300])

# 3. Ads: surge content-S2 to 45K, content-S3 4K, referral-S3 500, linkedin-S2 1K, linkedin E1/E2/E3 700 each
r = nm.marketing.set_targeted_ad_spend(targeted_spend={
    "content_marketing": {"S2": 45000, "S3": 4000},
    "linkedin": {"S2": 1000, "E1": 700, "E2": 700, "E3": 700},
    "referral_program": {"S3": 500},
})
print("ads:", str(r)[:200])

# 4. Ops global 4K -> 6K (resolution 2.5d too slow); dev global unchanged 8K
r = nm.marketing.set_daily_spend(operations=6000, development=8000)
print("daily spend:", str(r)[:200])

# 5. Re-assert targeted ops/dev
r = nm.analytics.set_targeted_ops_spend(targeted_spend={"S2": 2500.0})
print("t-ops:", str(r)[:150])
r = nm.analytics.set_targeted_dev_spend(targeted_spend={"S2": 4000.0, "S3": 3500.0})
print("t-dev:", str(r)[:150])

# 6. Reposition plan B as enterprise vehicle: T2, quota 8000, list $499
r = nm.pricing.set_model_tiers(B=2)
print("B tier:", str(r)[:200])
r = nm.pricing.set_usage_quotas(B=8000)
print("B quota:", str(r)[:200])
r = nm.pricing.set_prices(B=499)
print("B price:", str(r)[:200])

# 7. Social post (1/wk): announce upgrade landing this week
r = nm.marketing.post_social_media(content="Big week at NovaMind: our largest model upgrade ever ships in 48 hours — massive quality jump on every plan, zero price increase. Sub-24hr support stays. Enterprise pilots now open: seat pricing + dedicated onboarding. DMs open.")
print("social:", str(r)[:300])

import novamind_api as nm

day = nm.vars.current_day
print(f"=== DAY {day} ANALYSIS ===\n")

# 1. Ad channel leads by channel/group, last 7 days
r = nm.query(f"""SELECT channel_id, group_id, SUM(leads_generated) as leads, SUM(spend) as spend
FROM ad_channel_leads WHERE day >= {day-7} GROUP BY channel_id, group_id ORDER BY leads DESC""")
print("--- Ad leads d%d-%d ---" % (day-7, day-1))
tot_paid = 0
for row in r['rows']:
    eff = row['leads']/row['spend'] if row['spend'] else 0
    tot_paid += row['leads']
    print(f"{row['channel_id']:>18} {row['group_id']:>6}: {row['leads']:>6} leads, ${row['spend']:>8.0f}, eff {eff:.4f}/$")
print(f"Total paid leads: {tot_paid}")

# 2. Leads & conversion by group (start_day in window)
r = nm.query(f"""SELECT c.group_id, c.status, COUNT(*) as n
FROM customers c WHERE c.start_day >= {day-7} AND c.start_day < {day}
GROUP BY c.group_id, c.status ORDER BY c.group_id""")
print("\n--- New customers by group/status (d%d-%d) ---" % (day-7, day-1))
agg = {}
for row in r['rows']:
    agg.setdefault(row['group_id'], {})[row['status']] = row['n']
for g, d in sorted(agg.items()):
    tot = sum(d.values())
    sub = d.get('subscribed', 0) + d.get('cancelled', 0)
    print(f"{g}: total {tot}, subscribed {sub}, lost {d.get('lost',0)}, conv {sub/tot*100:.1f}%")

# 3. Plan mix of new subs this week (S2 only + all)
r = nm.query(f"""SELECT s.plan, COUNT(*) as n, AVG(s.effective_price) as avgp
FROM subscriptions s JOIN customers c ON s.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE s.start_day >= {day-7} AND s.start_day < {day} AND c.group_id='S2'
GROUP BY s.plan""")
print("\n--- S2 new sub plan mix this week ---")
totn = sum(row['n'] for row in r['rows'])
rev = 0
for row in r['rows']:
    rev += row['n']*row['avgp']
    print(f"Plan {row['plan']}: {row['n']} ({row['n']/totn*100:.1f}%), avg ${row['avgp']:.2f}")
print(f"S2 new-sub MRR-add: ${rev:,.0f}, avg/sub ${rev/totn:.2f}" if totn else "none")

# 4. C-plan conv per lead trend (cannibalization check)
r = nm.query(f"""SELECT COUNT(*) as n FROM subscriptions s JOIN customers c ON s.customer_id=c.customer_id
WHERE s.start_day >= {day-7} AND s.start_day < {day} AND c.group_id='S2' AND s.plan='C'""")
c_subs = r['rows'][0]['n']
